description: Emerson Electric Co. is a global technology and software company that provides innovative solutions for customers in a wide range of end markets around the world, and through its leading automation portfolio it helps process, hybrid and discrete manufacturers optimize operations, protect personnel, reduce emissions and achieve their sustainability goals, with sales by geographic destination in 2025 of the Americas at 51 percent, Asia, Middle East and Africa at 30 percent including China at 10 percent, and Europe at 19 percent. Portfolio management is an integral component of its growth and value creation strategy, and over the past three years it has taken significant actions to accelerate the transformation of its portfolio through the completion of strategic acquisitions and divestitures of non-core businesses, creating a cohesive, higher growth, higher margin industrial technology portfolio and making it a global automation leader serving a diversified set of end markets. It was incorporated in Missouri in 1890.
